⚖️ Key Constitutional Rules

  • Membership: Open to officially enrolled students; no membership fees charged.
  • President Tenure: Holds office for a maximum of two (2) consecutive years.
  • Annual Elections: Conducted on the last Friday of July via secret balloting or viva voce.
  • Voting Rules: Voting and nomination in absentia are strictly prohibited.

Important Announcement🕑 Posted 2 hrs ago

📚 Call for Participants: Book Week Celebration 2026

Get ready, bookworms! The Book Lovers' Club is officially opening registrations for the upcoming Book Week Celebration on November 26, 2026.

Featured Contests: Quiz Bee, Poster-Making, and Digital Book Cover Design

Eligibility: Open to all enrolled students across COED, COM, COAG, and CICI

Registration Deadline: November 20, 2026

Interested participants may approach any Department Representative or message our official P.I.O. team.

📢 Mandatory General Officers & Members Meeting

Please be reminded of our monthly assembly this coming Friday at the Campus Library. Attendance will be recorded by our P.C.O.s.

Accomplishment Report

Book Lovers' Club Launches New Library Newsletter

The Book Lovers' Club has published a new newsletter dedicated to showcasing the latest happenings inside the library. Curated by club members, the edition highlights key internal events and updates, including plans for the upcoming Book Month celebration, an introductory feature on the new librarian, and progress reports on current library renovations.

Highlights: Book Month plans • New librarian feature • Library renovation progress • Officers' election story
